tasks.title: Setup Flutter Project
tasks.description: Initialize a new Flutter project with necessary configurations for Android, iOS, Web, and Linux platforms.
tasks.details: Create Flutter project via `flutter create life_growth`. Configure the project for Android, iOS, Web, and Linux platforms. Update platform-specific configurations, including application IDs and metadata. Add `flutter_lints` for code linting and formatting. Initialize Git repository for version control. Prepare Supabase and platform secrets management for Task 2 dependency setup.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the Flutter project builds successfully for Android, iOS, Web, and Linux. Check that linting rules are applied correctly. Verify the app runs on Chrome.

tasks.title: Configure Supabase Backend
tasks.description: Set up Supabase as the backend, including authentication and database.
tasks.details: Create a new Supabase project. Enable email/password and OAuth authentication methods. Define the `daily_tasks` table in Supabase using the provided SQL DDL. Implement RLS policies as specified in the PRD. Ensure `updated_at` trigger and `set_user_id_from_auth` function are correctly set up. Use `supabase flutter` CLI for Flutter integration.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the `daily_tasks` table is created with the correct schema and RLS policies. Test authentication using email/password and OAuth. Confirm that the `updated_at` trigger and `set_user_id_from_auth` function work as expected.

tasks.title: Implement Supabase Authentication
tasks.description: Integrate Supabase authentication into the Flutter app.
tasks.details: Use the `supabase_flutter` package (latest version) to integrate Supabase authentication. Implement login, logout, and signup functionalities using email/password and OAuth. Store the user session securely. Handle authentication state changes using `SupabaseAuthListener`. Implement biometric lock using `local_auth` package (latest version).
tasks.testStrategy: Test login, logout, and signup functionalities with valid and invalid credentials. Verify that the user session is stored securely. Confirm that biometric lock works correctly.

tasks.title: Setup Local SQLite Database (Drift)
tasks.description: Set up local SQLite database using Drift for offline storage.
tasks.details: Add `drift` and `sqlite3_flutter_libs` (latest versions) dependencies to the project. Define the database schema in Drift, mirroring the `daily_tasks` table in Supabase. Implement DAOs (Data Access Objects) for CRUD operations. Configure Drift to use SQLite in Flutter. Implement schema versioning and automated migrations using Drift's migration system.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the local SQLite database is created with the correct schema. Test CRUD operations using DAOs. Confirm that schema migrations work correctly.

tasks.title: Implement Background Sync
tasks.description: Implement background sync between local SQLite and Supabase.
tasks.details: Use `workmanager` package (latest version) for background sync. Implement a sync service that periodically checks for changes in the local SQLite database and syncs them to Supabase. Handle conflicts using the last-updated-wins strategy with opportunistic field-wise merge. Implement a brief in-app notice for sync confirmations. Use `flutter_local_notifications` (latest version) for local notifications.
tasks.testStrategy: Test background sync with various network conditions (online, offline, intermittent). Verify that conflicts are resolved correctly. Confirm that the in-app notice is displayed after sync. Test local notifications.

tasks.title: Implement Daily Check-in Screen
tasks.description: Implement the Daily Check-in screen with task toggles and detail inputs.
tasks.details: Create a UI for the Daily Check-in screen with a list of tasks and toggles for completion. Implement a bottom sheet or dialog for entering task details (pages, minutes, steps, etc.). Use `intl` package (latest version) for date and time formatting. Implement input validation for numeric fields. Use `flutter_material_pickers` (latest version) for time pickers.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the Daily Check-in screen displays the correct tasks and toggles. Test entering task details with valid and invalid inputs. Confirm that the UI is responsive and accessible.

tasks.title: Implement History View and Edit
tasks.description: Implement history view, edit, soft delete, and restore functionalities.
tasks.details: Create a UI for viewing past days' logs. Implement inline editing of task details. Implement soft delete functionality by setting the `deleted_at` timestamp. Implement restore functionality for soft-deleted items within 7 days. Use `table_calendar` package (latest version) for calendar view.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the history view displays the correct logs. Test inline editing of task details. Confirm that soft delete and restore functionalities work correctly.

tasks.title: Implement Basic Analytics
tasks.description: Implement basic analytics (totals, completion rates, streaks).
tasks.details: Calculate weekly/monthly totals for minutes, pages, and steps. Calculate completion rates for each task. Calculate streaks for consecutive days completed per task and overall. Display analytics using charts and graphs. Use `fl_chart` package (latest version) for charts.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the analytics are calculated correctly. Confirm that the charts and graphs display the data accurately.

tasks.title: Implement Local Reminders
tasks.details: Use `flutter_local_notifications` package (latest version) to implement local reminders. Allow users to set a daily reminder and per-task reminders. Implement snooze and turn off functionalities.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that local reminders are triggered at the correct time. Test snooze and turn off functionalities.

tasks.title: Implement Undo Functionality
tasks.description: Implement undo functionality for edits and deletes.
tasks.details: Use `provider` package (latest version) for state management. Store the previous state before each edit or delete. Implement an undo button that restores the previous state.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the undo functionality restores the previous state correctly.

tasks.title: Implement CSV Export
tasks.details: Use `csv` package (latest version) to generate CSV files. Allow users to export their data to a CSV file. Use `share_plus` package (latest version) to share the CSV file.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that the CSV file is generated correctly. Confirm that the CSV file can be shared successfully.

tasks.title: Implement Personalization Options
tasks.description: Implement personalization options (reordering tasks, hiding tasks, renaming Avoid X, toggling Avoid Sweets).
tasks.details: Allow users to reorder tasks using drag and drop. Allow users to hide tasks they don't use. Allow users to rename the Avoid X label. Allow users to toggle the Avoid Sweets task on/off. Store personalization settings locally using `shared_preferences` package (latest version).
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that personalization options are saved and applied correctly.

tasks.title: Implement Accessibility Features
tasks.description: Implement accessibility features (48x48 dp tap targets, screen reader labels, color contrast, dark mode).
tasks.details: Ensure all interactive elements meet the 48x48 dp minimum tap target size. Add screen reader labels to all interactive elements. Ensure colors meet contrast standards. Implement dark mode using `ThemeData.dark()`.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that all accessibility features are implemented correctly using accessibility tools.

tasks.title: Implement Telemetry, Logging, and Error Handling
tasks.description: Implement telemetry, logging, and error handling.
tasks.details: Use `firebase_analytics` package (latest version) for anonymous event telemetry. Track task toggles, detail edits, sync starts/finishes, and errors. Use `flutter_sentry` package (latest version) for error reporting. Implement non-blocking toasts for sync and conflict notices using `fluttertoast` package (latest version).
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that telemetry events are tracked correctly. Confirm that errors are reported correctly. Test that non-blocking toasts are displayed for sync and conflict notices.

tasks.title: Implement Migrations and Data Integrity
tasks.description: Implement migrations and data integrity checks.
tasks.details: Implement SQLite migrations using Drift's migration system. Enforce non-negative numeric values, valid stretch_type, and notes length in the database. Enforce duration caps in the app. Use upserts consistently to prevent duplicate rows.
tasks.testStrategy: Verify that migrations are executed correctly. Confirm that data integrity checks are enforced.
